mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_SEQ FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
SELECT STATUS FROM MATCH_QUEUE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND MATCH_TYPE = 'IDEAL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCH_QUEUE (MEMBER_SEQ, MATCH_TYPE, STATUS) VALUES (#{memberSeq}, 'IDEAL', 'WAITING')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MATCH_QUEUE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND MATCH_TYPE = 'IDEAL' AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_SEQ FROM MATCH_QUEUE WHERE MATCH_TYPE = 'IDEAL' AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.update: UPDATE MATCH_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'MATCHED' WHERE MEMBER_SEQ IN (#{memberSeq}, #{targetSeq}) AND MATCH_TYPE = 'IDEAL' AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_IDEAL_MATCHING.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO IDEAL_MATCHING (IDEAL_MATCHING_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ_1, MEMBER_SEQ_2, SCORE, SCORE_1_TO_2, SCORE_2_TO_1, STATUS) VALUES (#{idealMatchingSeq}, #{memberSeq1}, #{memberSeq2}, #{score}, #{score1To2}, #{score2To1}, 'MATCHED')

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, MATCHING_SEQ, CREATED_BY, ROOM_STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{chatRoomSeq}, NULL, 'IDEAL', #{idealMatchingSeq}, #{memberSeq1}, 'Y', SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO CHAT_PARTICIPANT (CHAT_PARTICIPANT_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PARTICIPANT_ROLE, PARTICIPANT_STATUS, JOINED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_CHAT_PARTICIPANT.NEXTVAL, #{chatRoomSeq}, #{memberSeq}, #{role}, 'JOINED', SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_LIST (CHAT_ROOM_LIST_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, STATUS, LAST_READ_MESSAGE_SEQ, DELETED_MESSAGE_SEQ, LEFT_AT, DELETED_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_CHAT_ROOM_LIST.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{chatRoomSeq}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT im.IDEAL_MATCHING_SEQ, im.MEMBER_SEQ_1, im.MEMBER_SEQ_2, im.SCORE, im.SCORE_1_TO_2, im.SCORE_2_TO_1, im.STATUS, im.MATCHED_AT, im.ENDED_AT, r.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ FROM IDEAL_MATCHING im JOIN CHAT_ROOM r ON r.MATCHING_SEQ = im.IDEAL_MATCHING_SEQ AND r.ROOM_TYPE = 'IDEAL' WHERE (im.MEMBER_SEQ_1 = #{memberSeq} OR im.MEMBER_SEQ_2 = #{memberSeq}) ORDER BY im.MATCHED_AT DESC, im.IDEAL_MATCHING_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT r.ROOM_TYPE AS room_type, NVL(p.NICKNAME, m.NICKNAME) AS nickname, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, m.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS age, p.MBTI AS mbti, p.JOB AS job, p.INTRODUCTION AS introduction, p.HOBBY AS hobby FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN CHAT_PARTICIPANT mine ON mine.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = r.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND mine.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} JOIN CHAT_PARTICIPANT partner ON partner.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = r.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND partner.MEMBER_SEQ <> #{memberSeq} JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = partner.MEMBER_SEQ LEFT JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE p ON p.MEMBER_SEQ = partner.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE r.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{chatRoomSeq} AND r.ROOM_TYPE IN ('IDEAL', 'BLIND') AND ROWNUM = 1
